text: OVERDOSAGE Neither accidental nor intentional overdosing with ursodiol capsules has been reported. Doses of ursodiol capsules in the range of 16 - 20 mg/kg/day have been tolerated for 6 to 37 months without symptoms by 7 patients. The LD 50 for ursodiol in rats is over 5,000 mg/kg given over 7 to 10 days and over 7,500 mg/kg for mice. The most likely manifestation of severe overdose with ursodiol capsules would probably be diarrhea, which should be treated symptomatically.
